verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents API Access Tokens that authenticate and grant access to specific resources like CKS clusters and VPCs, and describes keeping credentials secure via kubeconfig management, which implies some resource-scoped access control. However, there is no explicit documentation of fine-grained least-privilege scoping (e.g., per-action or per-agent permission policies) or any agent-specific credential issuance workflow. missing for 10: explicit RBAC/least-privilege scoping controls, documentation of issuing narrowly-scoped tokens for autonomous agents, and any independent verification of this behavior.
